title: Twinwright agent request (twinwright.agent.v1)
description: The one JSON object Twinwright writes to an agent's stdin, followed by end of file. An agent should ignore request fields it does not recognise.

protocol.description: Always twinwright.agent.v1. An agent that speaks another version should exit non-zero.

task.description: What the agent is asked to do, as given to the run.

history.description: The conversation so far, exactly as the run's ledger records it: assistant turns, and one tool message per executed call carrying the HTTP status and the response body.

content.description: The assistant's text, or for a tool message the response body as a string.

tool_calls.description: On an assistant message, the calls it proposed.

call_id.description: On a tool message, the id of the call it answers.

operation_id.description: On a tool message, the operation that was called.

status.description: On a tool message, the HTTP status the simulated service returned.

raw_output.description: A hosted provider's own output items. Present only on turns made by such a provider.

interruptions.description: Attempts that produced no turn before this one did.

operations.description: The operations the agent may propose calls to. Only those the run's policy exposes are listed.

operation_id.description: The id to use as operation_id in a tool call.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema object for the call's arguments.
